name: Fire & Ice Glow
description: Dual-tone effect: warm orange-red flames lick upward from the liquid surface while cool blue-white frost crystals form and shatter along the cauldron rim. The two zones pulse alternately.

name: Golden Blue Shimmer
description: Liquid shifts between warm gold and cool sapphire blue in slow waves. Surface catches light like oil on water, producing iridescent ripples that travel outward from center.

name: Starfield
description: Tiny white-gold motes rise slowly from the liquid surface like stars ascending. The brew itself is deep midnight blue. Motes twinkle and fade at varying heights above the cauldron.

name: Truth Ripple
description: Concentric golden rings pulse outward from the center of the liquid surface at regular intervals, like a stone dropped in still water. Each ring emits a faint warm glow before dissolving.

name: Divine Glow
description: Intense warm golden luminescence radiates from within the liquid. A soft halo of light extends above the cauldron rim. Faint golden dust motes drift upward in gentle spirals.

name: Void Absorption
description: The liquid is impossibly black — it absorbs ambient light around it, creating a visible dark halo. Nearby particles and light sources dim. Occasional deep purple flickers in the depths.

name: Phoenix Flames
description: Crimson and gold flame particles erupt from the liquid surface in rhythmic bursts, curling upward like feathers. Embers drift and fade. The liquid itself glows molten orange-red.

name: Silence Aura
description: A translucent silver-white dome of still air forms above the liquid. No particles move within it. The brew is pale silver-lavender. The stillness itself feels visible — ambient particles avoid the zone.

name: Primordial Bubble
description: Large, slow amber bubbles rise from deep within the liquid and pop with a golden flash. The brew is murky amber-brown with sediment swirling. Each bubble leaves a brief glowing ring on the surface.

name: Rainbow Explosion
description: The liquid cycles through the full spectrum — red, orange, gold, green, blue, indigo, violet — in smooth transitions. Particle bursts of each color erupt at the transition points. Pure chromatic chaos.

name: Floral Mist
description: Soft pink and lavender mist rises gently from the liquid surface, dissipating at cauldron-rim height. Tiny petal-shaped particles drift within the mist. Calming and delicate.

name: Golden Glow
description: Warm golden light emanates steadily from the liquid. A simple, clean luminescence with no particles — just the brew itself glowing like liquid sunlight.

name: Dark Smoke
description: Thick charcoal-gray smoke curls upward from the liquid in lazy tendrils. The brew is deep brown-black. Smoke clings close to the surface before slowly rising and thinning.

name: Frost Sparkle
description: Ice-blue crystalline particles form on the cauldron walls and rim, then shatter into tiny sparkling fragments that float briefly. The liquid is pale blue-white with a cold sheen.

name: Amber Warmth
description: A soft, steady amber glow with occasional warm orange bubbles rising lazily. Like looking into a fireplace ember. Cozy and inviting.

name: Crimson Embers
description: Deep red liquid with tiny bright ember particles floating upward like sparks from a campfire. Occasional flare-ups along the surface.

name: Emerald Shimmer
description: Rich green liquid with a shifting pearlescent surface. Light catches and refracts in green-gold waves across the surface like sunlight through leaves.

name: Violet Haze
description: Deep purple liquid with a soft violet fog hovering just above the surface. Dreamlike and mysterious. Faint purple sparkles within the haze.

name: Copper Bubbles
description: Warm copper-colored liquid with steady streams of small metallic-sheen bubbles. Surface has a slight bronze mirror quality.

name: Pale Moonlight
description: Very pale silvery-white liquid that seems to emit its own faint cold light. Tiny silver motes drift upward like dust in a moonbeam.
